title: DeliMF: Gated Cross-Attention Fusion of Structured Time Series and Clinical Text for Early Intensive Care Delirium Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.24585v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Delirium affects a large fraction of intensive care unit (ICU) patients and foreshadows longer stays, lasting cognitive decline, and higher mortality. Flagging the patients who will become delirious within the first day of admission would give clinicians a window to intervene. Yet state-of-the-art predictors rely only on the structured electronic health record (EHR) of vital signs, laboratory values, and medications, while overlooking the free-text clinical notes written in the same window, which carry information the numbers cannot encode. To this end, we present DeliMF, a multimodal framework that fuses the structured time series with clinical text. It encodes the structured signals with a temporal Transformer and the time-stamped radiology reports with a clinical text encoder, and fuses the two through a gated cross-attention module. translated_title: DeliMF：门控交叉注意力融合结构化时间序列与临床文本用于早期重症监护谵妄预测
translated_abstract: 谵妄影响很大一部分重症监护病房（ICU）患者，并预示着更长的住院时间、持久的认知衰退和更高的死亡率。在患者入院第一天内识别出将会发生谵妄的患者，将为临床医生提供宝贵的干预窗口。然而，目前最先进的预测方法仅依赖于结构化电子健康记录（EHR）中的生命体征、实验室数值和药物信息，而忽视了在同一时间窗口内撰写的自由文本临床笔记，这些笔记蕴含着数字数据无法编码的信息。为此，我们提出了DeliMF，一个将结构化时间序列与临床文本融合的多模态框架。该框架使用时间Transformer编码结构化信号，使用临床文本编码器编码带时间戳的放射学报告，并通过门控交叉注意力模块将两者融合。该门控机制为文本学习针对每个患者的权重；当患者没有笔记时，门控关闭……
tldr: DeliMF通过门控交叉注意力将结构化时间序列与临床文本融合，实现了ICU患者入院首日的早期谵妄预测，弥补了传统方法仅依赖结构化数据而忽略临床笔记信息的不足。
